aiVoltageMax.description: Upper end of the analog-input range, in volts. A signal above it is clipped flat by the card with no error.

aiVoltageMin.description: Lower end of the analog-input range handed to the driver, in volts. Declare the preamp's real swing: a small signal on a wide range wastes ADC resolution. The card coerces the pair up to the nearest range it has.

analogInputLine.description: NI-DAQ analog input line the PMT is wired to.  If an int ``N`` is given it is expanded to ``"<deviceName>/ai<N>"``; otherwise the string is used verbatim.

deviceName.description: NI-DAQ device prefix used when ``analogInputLine`` is given as an int.

liveUpdateIntervalMs.description: Minimum wall-clock gap between live-preview redraws during a scan (50 ms = 20 Hz).  Same meaning as for ``APDManager``; bounds GUI redraws only, never acquired data.

mockRandomSeed.description: Seed of the mock source's random generator, for reproducible mock scans.  Also read as ``mock_random_seed``.

mockVoltageMax.description: Upper bound of the mock voltage signal.  Also read as ``mock_voltage_max``.

mockVoltageMean.description: Mean of the mock voltage signal.  Also read as ``mock_voltage_mean``.

mockVoltageMin.description: Lower bound of the mock voltage signal.  Also read as ``mock_voltage_min``; swapped with the maximum if given the wrong way round.

mockVoltageNoiseStd.description: Standard deviation of the mock signal's noise (clamped at 0).  Also read as ``mock_voltage_noise_std``.

mock_random_seed.description: Seed of the mock source's random generator, for reproducible mock scans.  Also read as ``mock_random_seed``.

mock_voltage_max.description: Upper bound of the mock voltage signal.  Also read as ``mock_voltage_max``.

mock_voltage_mean.description: Mean of the mock voltage signal.  Also read as ``mock_voltage_mean``.

mock_voltage_min.description: Lower bound of the mock voltage signal.  Also read as ``mock_voltage_min``; swapped with the maximum if given the wrong way round.

mock_voltage_noise_std.description: Standard deviation of the mock signal's noise (clamped at 0).  Also read as ``mock_voltage_noise_std``.

offset_v.description: Voltage offset subtracted from each sample before being treated as signal.

simulation_mode.description: Run the mock voltage source instead of the NI-DAQ analog-input task, even when a DAQ is present.
